title.en: polarzauber christmas market at the hauptbahnhof.

line.en: the christmas market under the main station, open until 22:00 on thursdays, fridays and saturdays. it runs until 24 december, so there is time later in the month too.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt unter dem hauptbahnhof, donnerstag bis samstag bis 22:00 geöffnet. er läuft bis 24. dezember, also bleibt auch später im monat zeit.
line.tr: ana istasyonun altındaki noel pazarı, perşembe, cuma ve cumartesi 22:00'ye kadar açık. 24 aralık'a kadar sürüyor, ayın ilerleyen günlerinde de vakit var.

sparks.why: Polarzauber (former Christkindlimarkt) at Zürich Hauptbahnhof, 19 Nov to 24 Dec 2026, Thu to Sat 11:00 to 22:00 (twtravel.de); dates also in swissactivities.com; hours from one source only.
